svg.title: DOGGO RAG: Project Overview Preview
svg.desc: Motivation, web application preview, and the four steps of the DOGGO RAG inference pipeline.
svg.text: A Minimal Experiment in VLM Pipeline Design

text.tspan: : Prototype AI pipelines while experimenting with model selection, RAG, and prompt engineering.
: Use intuitive dog recognition to explore the pipeline while testing challenging cases like dingoes.

svg.text: Select an image and model, then inspect the result of each stage.
WEB UI • Local application with a dataset image selected, before inference.
The same VLM examines the original image twice; the first description guides retrieval.
Select or upload the original image.
Classify the image and generate a visual description.
Use the description to retrieve species knowledge.
Re-examine the original image with the retrieved knowledge.
The evaluation compares both passes and a no-notes control; see Figure 02 for results.
FastAPI • MLX / MLX-VLM • MiniLM • FAISS • BM25
